notes: Added missing schema/contract and audit/logging coverage to complete enforcement surface.

GPTR-F-001-S159.title: Allowlist Schema and Contract Definition
GPTR-F-001-S159.description: Define the formal allowlist schema for GPTReader requests including permitted collections, fields, operators, and limits, implemented as a strict validation contract (e.g., Pydantic model) to standardize enforcement inputs.

GPTR-F-001-S160.title: Request Normalization and Pre-Validation Layer
GPTR-F-001-S160.description: Implement a preprocessing layer that normalizes incoming GPTReader queries (field casing, operator standardization, default limits) before allowlist enforcement to eliminate bypass via malformed inputs.

GPTR-F-001-S161.title: Enforcement Audit Logging
GPTR-F-001-S161.description: Extend GPTReader audit logging to capture enforcement decisions including rejected queries, violation types, and metadata for traceability and security review without exposing sensitive data.
